components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Used for form submits, CTA actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f97316; color: #0d0c0b; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ea6c12; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(249,115,22,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f97316; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.3; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Used for cancel, navigate-back, destructive confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #ccc4bc; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #454038; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f97316; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Data Card
components.description: The primary content container. Wraps all metric groupings.
components.html:
Recovery

87%
components.css: .ds-card { background: #38302a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 17px; padding: 16px; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.20); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-label { font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #ccc4bc; } .ds-card-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(249,115,22,0.10); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-card-metric { font-family: "Barlow Condensed", Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #f97316; } .ds-card-unit { font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #ccc4bc; margin-left: 2px; vertical-align: baseline; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Linear progress indicator. Orange when incomplete, green when target met.
components.css: .ds-progress { width: 100%; height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f97316; transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-progress-fill.complete { background: #22c55e; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic state pill. Green/Yellow/Red for recovery zone; Orange for primary context.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid; } .ds-badge-green { background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15); color: #22c55e; border-color: rgba(34,197,94,0.30); } .ds-badge-orange { background: rgba(249,115,22,0.15); color: #f97316; border-color: rgba(249,115,22,0.30); } .ds-badge-yellow { background: rgba(234,179,8,0.15); color: #eab308; border-color: rgba(234,179,8,0.30); } .ds-badge-red { background: rgba(255,107,107,0.15); color: #ff6b6b; border-color: rgba(255,107,107,0.30); }

components.description: Active navigation state — sidebar and bottom tab.

narrative.overview:
Apex is instrumentation, not an application. Every screen exists to surface one answer fast: what does my body need right now? The aesthetic is clinical but not cold — warm-toned materials (brown, bone, amber) stand in for the stainless steel of an actual lab. Numbers are the primary design element; spacing, typography, and hierarchy exist only to make them scannable in under two seconds.

The system rejects everything that dilutes signal: no background illustrations, no achievement iconography, no encouraging microcopy that restates what the data already says. Information density is a feature, not a problem to solve. Cards are grouping devices, not decorative containers. Glow is reserved for live state and alert, never ornament.

This is a tool for one person who understands what HRV, strain, and sleep performance mean. It does not explain. It does not celebrate. It reports.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-brown dark palette grounded by a single orange accent at ≤15% surface coverage
Condensed bold numerals (Barlow Condensed 700) as the dominant visual element
Flat tonal layering for depth; no drop shadows
Uppercase micro-labels (10px, 700 weight, tracked wide) as the taxonomic layer
All interactive elements navigate to detail; the dashboard surface never expands inline

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange is the only non-semantic color on any given screen. Its scarcity is the signal.

rules.name: The Warm-Only Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is brown-shifted. Cool greys (zinc, slate) are prohibited.

rules.name: The Condensed-for-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value ≥1.5rem uses Barlow Condensed 700. Barlow regular is for prose.

rules.name: The Scale Gap Rule
rules.body: Labels (10px) and body (14px) have a 1.4× step. Headline (30px) and body (14px) have a 2.1× step. A flat scale is prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface has a shadow at rest. Shadow appears only as an interaction response or semantic alert.

dos: Do use Barlow Condensed 700 for every numeric value ≥1.5rem.
Do keep cards flat: bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl p-4.
Do use semantic colors only for their defined meaning.
Do use uppercase micro-labels (10px, 700, tracking-wide) for card category headings.
Do express hover states through border opacity shift and accent glow on primary elements.
Do use text-muted-foreground, bg-muted, bg-card, border-border Tailwind tokens.
donts: Don't introduce dense sidebar nav overload. Maximum five nav items.
Don't add achievement badges, streak counters, gamification iconography, or motivational filler copy.
Don't show twelve metrics per screen with no hierarchy.
Don't use cool greys (zinc-*, slate-* Tailwind utilities).
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as a colored accent).
Don't use violet, purple, or blue as decorative accents.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number, gradient accent, supporting stats ring).
